semantics.identity_rule: Universal Module identity resolves exactly to one active authoritative substrate contract.
semantics.ownership_rule: Registry lists substrates but does not own their semantics.
semantics.composition_rule: Domains reference Universal Module identities through this explicit registry/identity graph.
semantics.directory_rule: universal_module is storage organization only; registry identity is canonical.
semantics.history_rule: Superseded/historical module contracts may remain physically present but do not compete with active registry targets.

invariants.rule: Structural dimensions and registries remain explicit and are never collapsed into generic hierarchy.
